title: Domains of Monomial Convergence in Banach Sequence Spaces
summary: A classical phenomenon distinguishing infinite-dimensional holomorphy from its finite-dimensional counterpart is that monomial expansions of holomorphic functions need not converge absolutely. In this paper, we systematically investigate monomial convergence on complex Banach sequence spaces. We establish general structural results and give a negative answer to Lempert's problem. We then determine the domains of absolute monomial convergence for holomorphic functions on the classical Banach sequence spaces and obtain a complete classification for continuous homogeneous polynomials.
